2 19-10-2023 1.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. The petitioner has preferred this application for grant of regular bail in connection with Naubatpur P.S. Case no.420 of 2023 registered under sections 307, 341, 342, 323, 504, 506 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code and section 27 of the Arms Act.
3. As per the prosecution case, it is stated by the informant that Vijay Rai along with his sons which included the petitioner herein came variously armed.
Mukul Kumar is said to have fired from his country made pistol hitting the informant on his shoulders and leg.
All the persons are said to have assaulted the informant and the members of his family.
The petitioner is stated to have taken the gold chain of the informant.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.66958 of 2023(2) dt.19-10-2023 4.
Even as per the allegations in the F.I.R, no overt-act has been alleged against the petitioner who is in custody since 7.7.2023.
As per instructions received, other co-accused namely Vijay Rai, Rahul Kumar and Chunnu Kumar have been enlarged on anticipatory bail vide order dated 18.10.2023 passed in Cr. Misc. no. 58299 of Niraj Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191170897/
1 2023.
5.

opennyai_summary.16_January_2024__facts:
2. The petitioner has prayed for regular bail in a case instituted for the offence under Sections 414,
420/34 of the IPC and Sections 30(a), 32(ii), 34(ii) and 41(i) of the Bihar Prohibition and Excise Act.
3. As per prosecution case, there has been recovery of total 4205.52 liters of illegal liquor from different vehicles.
opennyai_summary.16_January_2024__arguments:
4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that petitioner has been falsely implicated in this case.
He has committed no offence.
He submitted that the petitioner has no concern either with the seized vehicles or with the wine in question.
He submitted that petitioner is a labour and he was called for unloading the truck without giving knowledge that Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.460 of 2024(2) dt.16-01-2024 liquor is loaded in the truck.
On the basis of suspicion, petitioner has been implicated in the present case.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
No incriminating article has been recovered from the conscious possession of the petitioner.
The provision of Section 100 of the Cr.P.C. has not been followed in this case, while preparing the seizure list.
opennyai_summary.16_January_2024__decision:
He is languishing in judicial custody since 08.11.2023.
5. The application for bail is opposed by learned APP for the State.
6. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering the facts and circumstances of the case as well as period of custody, this court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
The above named petitioner is directed to be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rs. ten thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Exclusive Special Prohibition and Excise Court-2-cum-Additional District and Sessions Judge, Vaishali at Hajipur in connection with Mahua P.S. Case No. 724 of 2023.

The petitioner apprehends arrest in connection with Samastipur Town P.S. Case No. 121 of 2023 instituted under Sections 420, 467, 468, 419 and 120B of the Indian Penal Code.
3. The petitioner is alleged to have furnished fake gold ornaments worth Rs. 4,28,900/- in the Axis Bank and obtained loan.
opennyai_summary.final__arguments:
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has denied the allegation and has submitted that without accepting the guilt, the petitioner is ready to pay the remaining amount i.e., Rs. 2,80,165/-
(including interest) to Axis Bank, Samastipur Branch Patna High Court CR.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
5. In view of the fact that the petitioner is ready to pay the remaining amount of loan to the Bank i.e.
Rs. 2,80,165/- (including interest), this application is allowed.
Let the petitioner, above named, in the event of arrest or surrender before the Court below within six weeks from today, be released on provisional anticipatory bail upon furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Samastipur in connection with Samastipur Town P.S. Case No.
121 of 2023, subject to the conditions laid down in Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure,1973.
7.
On the date on which the petitioner furnishes his bail bonds, he shall produce a demand draft of Rs. 1,25,000/- in the name of the Bank in question and only after furnishing the demand draft of Rs.
1,25,000/-, he shall be granted provisional anticipatory bail by the Court below.
Thereafter, the petitioner will pay the balance amount in four equal installments in the next four months.
8. After the entire amount of Rs. 2,80,165/- (including interest) is paid, the provisional anticipatory bail granted to the Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.76275 of 2024(3) dt.10-02-2025 petitioner shall be confirmed by the Court below.
9. If the petitioner fails to pay the entire amount, as stated above, the provisional anticipatory bail granted to the petitioner shall be cancelled by the Court below.
